entities.name: Chandelas of Jejakabhukti
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Chandelas of Jejakabhukti was an Indian dynasty in Central India. The Chandelas ruled much of the Bundelkhand region between the 9th and the 13th centuries. They belonged to the Chandel clan of the Rajputs.
